serena.description: LSP-powered semantic code analysis: TypeScript/JavaScript navigation, symbol search, refactoring, type checking, diagnostics. Tools: find_symbol, find_referencing_symbols, get_symbols_overview, rename_symbol, replace_symbol_body. Essential for codebase exploration and precise code modifications.

trello.description: Trello project management integration: board/list/card CRUD, task tracking, member assignments, labels, checklists, attachments, comments. Tools: get_lists, add_card_to_list, update_card_details, move_card, archive_card, create_checklist. Essential for task management and team collaboration.
